notes: src/Token.sol:Token takes no constructor arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 BRAIN (18 decimals) once to msg.sender. It is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with exact transfers and no owner, administrative controls, or external mint function. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. The pool uses the specified pair token, a 0.3% fee, and tick spacing 60. initialPrice is provenance only: floor(2^96 * sqrt(initialMarketCapWei / totalSupply)), expressed as paired-currency minor units per BRAIN minor unit under a BRAIN-as-currency0 convention. The deployer derives the actual opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply using the deployed currencies' address ordering.
